complaintTemplates.text: Da, aia Batang Kuranji alah masuak rumah di Kalumbuk, tingginyo alah sapinggang. Urang gaek jo anak-anak harus diungsian kini, tolong kirim parahu karet.

translation.id: Bang, air Batang Kuranji sudah masuk rumah di Kalumbuk, tingginya sudah sepinggang. Lansia dan anak-anak harus diungsikan sekarang, tolong kirim perahu karet.
translation.en: The Batang Kuranji has flooded homes in Kalumbuk and the water is waist-high. The elderly and children must be evacuated now, please send a rubber boat.

complaintTemplates.text: Mohon maaf, aia Batang Kandis alah naiak, sawah jo jalan di Batang Kabung alah tagenang. Kok hujan baliak malam ko, rumah warga bisa kamasuakan aia. Tolong dipantau.

translation.id: Mohon maaf, air Batang Kandis sudah naik, sawah dan jalan di Batang Kabung sudah tergenang. Kalau hujan lagi malam ini, rumah warga bisa kemasukan air. Mohon dipantau.
translation.en: Excuse me, the Batang Kandis is rising and the rice fields and road in Batang Kabung are flooded. If it rains again tonight, water could enter people's homes. Please monitor it.

complaintTemplates.text: Tanggua batang aia di balakang musajik bocor, aianyo marembeh taruih. Kok indak capek ditambal, sakampuang bisa kabanjiran malam ko.

translation.id: Tanggul sungai di belakang masjid bocor, airnya merembes terus. Kalau tidak segera ditambal, satu kampung bisa kebanjiran malam ini.
translation.en: The river embankment behind the mosque is leaking and water keeps seeping through. If it is not patched soon, the whole neighbourhood could flood tonight.

complaintTemplates.text: Banda di Ulak Karang sumbek, satiok hujan labek jalan tagenang sampai ka lutuik. Tolong dikuruak bandanyo.

translation.id: Selokan di Ulak Karang tersumbat, setiap hujan lebat jalan tergenang sampai lutut. Tolong selokannya dikeruk.
translation.en: The drain in Ulak Karang is blocked; every heavy rain floods the road knee-deep. Please dredge the drain.

complaintTemplates.text: Banjia alah tigo hari alun suruik, sumua warga karuah sadonyo. Paralu aia barasiah jo ubek-ubek, utamonyo untuak anak-anak jo urang gaek.

translation.id: Banjir sudah tiga hari belum surut, sumur warga keruh semua. Butuh air bersih dan obat-obatan, terutama untuk anak-anak dan lansia.
translation.en: The flood has not receded for three days and all the wells are muddy. We need clean water and medicine, especially for children and the elderly.

complaintTemplates.text: Jalan ka Lubuk Kilangan baluang-baluang gadang, alah banyak urang jatuah dari onda. Kok hujan, lubangnyo tatutuik aia jadi indak nampak. Tolong capek diparbaiki.

translation.id: Jalan ke Lubuk Kilangan berlubang-lubang besar, sudah banyak pengendara motor yang jatuh. Kalau hujan, lubangnya tertutup air jadi tidak kelihatan. Tolong segera diperbaiki.
translation.en: The road to Lubuk Kilangan is full of big potholes and many motorcyclists have fallen. When it rains the holes fill with water and cannot be seen. Please repair it soon.

complaintTemplates.text: Ambo nio manyampaikan, jalan di Pauh alah rusak barek, truk pangangkuik pasia acok tasangkuik. Mohon diparbaiki sabalum musim hujan.

translation.id: Saya ingin menyampaikan, jalan di Pauh sudah rusak berat, truk pengangkut pasir sering terjebak. Mohon diperbaiki sebelum musim hujan.
translation.en: I would like to report that the road in Pauh is badly damaged and sand trucks often get stuck. Please repair it before the rainy season.

complaintTemplates.text: Sarok di tapi jalan dakek pasa alah batumpuak saminggu indak diangkuik, baunyo indak karuan jo banyak langau. Kok hujan, saroknyo hanyuik masuak banda.

translation.id: Sampah di pinggir jalan dekat pasar sudah menumpuk seminggu tidak diangkut, baunya tidak karuan dan banyak lalat. Kalau hujan, sampahnya hanyut masuk selokan.
translation.en: Rubbish by the road near the market has piled up for a week without collection; it stinks and draws flies. When it rains it washes into the drains.

complaintTemplates.text: Lampu jalan di simpang ampek kampuang alah mati duo minggu, malam kalam bana. Banyak urang takuik lewat, cameh ado maliang.

translation.id: Lampu jalan di perempatan kampung sudah mati dua minggu, malam gelap sekali. Banyak orang takut lewat, khawatir ada pencuri.
translation.en: The street light at the neighbourhood crossroads has been out for two weeks and it is very dark at night. People are afraid to pass, worried about thieves.

complaintTemplates.text: Aia PDAM di rumah ambo alah tigo hari indak mangalia, kok mangalia pun hanyo malam hari jo karuah. Tolong dicek pipanyo.

translation.id: Air PDAM di rumah saya sudah tiga hari tidak mengalir, kalaupun mengalir hanya malam hari dan keruh. Tolong dicek pipanya.
translation.en: The piped water at my house has not run for three days; when it does, only at night and muddy. Please check the pipes.

complaintTemplates.text: Batang kayu gadang di tapi jalan tumbang dek angin, manutuik jalan jo kabel listrik putuih. Oto indak bisa lewat samo sakali.

translation.id: Pohon besar di pinggir jalan tumbang diterjang angin, menutup jalan dan kabel listrik putus. Kendaraan sama sekali tidak bisa lewat.
translation.en: A big tree by the road was blown down, blocking the road and snapping the power line. Vehicles cannot get through at all.

complaintTemplates.text: Mohon batanyo, Pak. Wakatu maurus surek pindah di kantua lurah, ambo dimintak pitih saratuih limo puluah ribu tanpa kuitansi. Apo memang ado biayonyo?

translation.id: Mohon tanya, Pak. Waktu mengurus surat pindah di kantor kelurahan, saya dimintai uang seratus lima puluh ribu tanpa kuitansi. Apakah memang ada biayanya?
translation.en: May I ask, Sir: when I processed a moving letter at the kelurahan office I was asked for 150,000 rupiah without a receipt. Is there really a fee?

complaintTemplates.text: Antrian di puskesmas panjang bana, doktornyo hanyo surang. Anak ambo alah tigo hari damam, dari pagi sampai siang alun dapek giliran.

translation.id: Antrean di puskesmas panjang sekali, dokternya hanya satu. Anak saya demam sudah tiga hari, dari pagi sampai siang belum dapat giliran.
translation.en: The queue at the health centre is very long and there is only one doctor. My child has had a fever for three days and has waited from morning to noon without being seen.

complaintTemplates.text: Di RT kami alah ado tigo anak kanai damam badarah minggu ko. Tolong di-fogging jo diparikso jentiknyo.

translation.id: Di RT kami sudah ada tiga anak kena demam berdarah minggu ini. Tolong dilakukan fogging dan pemeriksaan jentik.
translation.en: Three children in our neighbourhood have caught dengue this week. Please carry out fogging and a larva check.

complaintTemplates.text: Ambo alah maurus KTP-el sajak duo bulan nan lalu, sampai kini alun juo jadi, kecek urang blankonyo habih. Bilo bisa diambiak?

translation.id: Saya sudah mengurus KTP-el sejak dua bulan lalu, sampai sekarang belum jadi, katanya blankonya habis. Kapan bisa diambil?
translation.en: I applied for my e-ID two months ago and it is still not ready; they say the blank cards ran out. When can I collect it?

complaintTemplates.text: Nenek ambo alah gaek jo hiduik surang, a sabab namonyo ilang dari daftar bansos bulan ko? Padohal bulan lalu masih dapek. Tolong dicek, Da.

translation.id: Nenek saya sudah tua dan hidup sendiri, kenapa namanya hilang dari daftar bansos bulan ini? Padahal bulan lalu masih dapat. Tolong dicek, Bang.
translation.en: My grandmother is old and lives alone, so why has her name disappeared from this month's social-assistance list? She received it last month. Please check.

complaintTemplates.text: Atok kelas SD di kampuang ambo bocor jo kayunyo alah lapuak, anak-anak takuik kok hujan labek. Tolong capek diparbaiki sabalum runtuah.

translation.id: Atap kelas SD di kampung saya bocor dan kayunya sudah lapuk, anak-anak takut kalau hujan lebat. Tolong segera diperbaiki sebelum roboh.
translation.en: The primary-school classroom roof in my neighbourhood leaks and the timber is rotten; the children are scared in heavy rain. Please fix it before it collapses.
